mentions.name: Vicena.ai
mentions.description: AI research agent that makes scientists more productive and lets non-scientists do science. It integrates open-source and commercial simulators and models for chemistry, materials science, and biology, and connects to service labs and robot labs to run physical experiments. It runs an autoresearch optimization loop following the scientific method (observation, hypothesis, experiment, theory) with a long-term self-learning memory, and can be used interactively like a coding agent or delegated long-term research goals to work on autonomously 24/7 like a graduate student.
mentions.problem: Making scientific research more productive and accessible to non-scientists.
mentions.audience: Scientists and engineers doing research, with the goal of also making non-scientists productive in science.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on Vicena.ai, an agent to make scientists more productive, and make non-scientists into scientists.

- Integrated with lots of open-source and commercial simulators and models for chemistry, materials science, biology… As well as connections to service labs and robot labs to easily perform physical experiments.

- autoresearch / AlphaEvolve like optimization loop following the scientific method: observation, hypothesis, experiment, theory.
